Subject: BluePeak pilot - draft MAP + econ acceptance checklist

Hi Elena / Matt —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that focuses the pilot on two things: 1) evaluation for quality/regression against your critical flows, and 2) a short cost validation run to sanity‑check tokens/$ and caching/batching assumptions before procurement.

Quick highlights in the attached PDF and below:
- Evaluation plan: run our 2,000-case prompt set (attached eval_prompt_set_v1.csv) across your 3 canonical flows (search-assist, summary, and compliance rewrite).
- Cost validation: 48-hour continuous low-volume run (estimated 10k calls/day) to measure effective tokens consumed and cache hit rates with your live traffic shape.
- Acceptance criteria: latency P95 < 350ms for single-call flows, quality delta < 3% on your BLEU/QA metrics, and modeled tokens/$ within 20% of our forecast.

Please review the MAP draft and the minimal data/access asks in section 2.1. If that looks good I can lock dates and owners.

Proposed owners:
- Redwood: Stephanie (pilot owner), Rishi (SRE/ops + performance tuning)
- BluePeak: Elena (product), Matt (platform)

Deliverables & tentative timeline (quick):
- 2026-02-23: finalize eval prompt set & test account access
- 2026-02-24 — 2026-03-08: pilot run and intermediate check-ins
- 2026-03-10: evaluation review call + next steps (procurement/commitment)

Attachments: bluepeak_map_draft_20260218.pdf, eval_prompt_set_v1.csv

Thanks — aim to keep this lightweight and measurable.

Thanks Stephanie — PDF looks good at a high level. A few quick asks from our side before we sign off on dates:

1) Tokens & pricing baseline request — can you provide your expected tokens/$ for the model variant you plan to run (and any differences if we enable your KV prefix caching)? We need this to size a short P&L for the pilot.
2) Batching assumptions — our platform tends to batch small spikes (avg concurrency ~6). What batch sizes will Redwood target, and how will that affect latency numbers?
3) Data retention & logs — we need to confirm the retention window for request/response logs for the pilot for internal QA.

For context on usage shape: our test cohort will be ~250 daily active QA users (peak 1,200 calls/day across flows during the 48-hour run). Average tokens per call based on our representative cases is ~480 tokens (inputs + expected model outputs).

If you can send a short worked example (tokens -> cost -> adjusted for caching/hit-rate) that will let our finance/engineering folks greenlight the timeline.

— Elena Ruiz
Head of Product, BluePeak Analytics
elena@bluepeak.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: RE: BluePeak pilot - draft MAP + econ acceptance checklist (internal)

Internal calc snapshot for the pilot asks Elena sent. Notes and conservative assumptions so we have something to share quickly.

Assumptions:
- Test traffic: 250 DAU -> peak 1,200 calls/day during 48h window (BluePeak provided).
- Avg tokens per call (input + output): 480 tokens
- Baseline model choice: rdx-llama-70b-q4 (performance profile we've verified for similar flows)
- Pricing baseline used for forecast: $0.0008 per token (this equals ~1,250 tokens per $1) — conservative for hosted plan before any committed discount.
- Expected KV cache hit rate during pilot: 30% (their prompts contain repeated prefixes for search-assist).
- Batching: our runtime should be able to opportunistically batch average concurrency -> effective batch size ~6-8 for this test; use 8 for perf math as a conservative latency-friendly batch.

Worked example (48-hour window, peak distribution approximated as flat for simplicity):
- Total calls over 2 days: assume 1,200 calls/day * 2 = 2,400 calls
- Raw tokens consumed (no cache): 2,400 * 480 = 1,152,000 tokens
- With 30% KV cache hit => token reduction = 1,152,000 * 0.30 = 345,600 saved tokens => effective tokens billed = 806,400 tokens
- Cost estimate: 806,400 tokens * $0.0008/token = $645.12 for the 48-hour run
- Adjust for batching efficiency (batching reduces overhead but billing is per-token — main cost saving is from less tail/overhead ops; assume <5% additional efficiency in tokens billed — ignore for pilot to be conservative)

Monthlyized extrapolation if pilot looked like production (for their 250 DAU steady state):
- 1,200 calls/day * 30 = 36,000 calls/month -> tokens/mo (no cache) = 36,000 * 480 = 17,280,000 tokens -> at $0.0008 = $13,824/month
- With 30% cache hit => ~12,158,000 tokens billed -> ~$9,726/month

Action items for us before we send to BluePeak:
- Validate model variant (confirm rdx-llama-70b-q4 is acceptable)
- Double-check the cache hit estimate with RPT analysis or sample data (ask BluePeak for a small sample of 200 sessions)
- Produce a one‑page worked example we can share in the MAP (Rishi to draft)

I'll draft the one-pager and attach to the MAP. If we share conservative numbers and show upside with simple caching/batching, BluePeak should be fine with the timeline.

— Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Elena / Matt —

Appreciate the detail. Per Rishi's internal check above, here is a short worked example and a tightened MAP timeline. We're keeping conservative assumptions and surface-level knobs so your finance team can sign off quickly.

Worked example (we'll add as a one-pager in the MAP):
- Baseline: 480 tokens/call, 1,200 calls/day during test window -> 2,400 calls over 48 hours
- Cache hit: 30% -> effective billed tokens = 806,400 -> cost ~$645 (using $0.0008/token)
- Upside: if cache hit is 50% (easy for search-assist with aggressive prefix caching) -> billed tokens ~576,000 -> cost ~$460
- Latency note (batch size 8): expected P95 in pilot ~280–340ms depending on peak alignment; we can enable burst single-request routing for strict low-latency flows.

Tightened MAP milestones (owners):
- 2026-02-22 (Neha): sign off on data sharing checklist + send sample 200 sessions for cache analysis
- 2026-02-23 (Stephanie/Rishi): finalize eval prompt set, attach one-pager cost worked example to MAP
- 2026-02-24 — 2026-03-08 (Rishi/BluePeak infra): pilot run (intermediate check-in 2/27)
- 2026-03-10 (Stephanie/BluePeak): evaluation review + procurement next steps

Please confirm the 2/22 data sample and if the pilot window still aligns with your internal QA availability. Once we have that sample we'll run a quick prefix-match pass to refine cache hit rate and update the MAP numbers.

Attachments (to be uploaded to the MAP): bluepeak_map_draft_20260218.pdf, eval_prompt_set_v1.csv, bluepeak_cost_onepager_20260220.pdf (draft)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
